description: Land Title Settlement Department - Sitinamaluwa, Beliatta D/S Division, Hambanthota District Cad. Map No. 830116 and other declarations
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including details about parcel numbers, extent, ownership, title class, and encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses on land registration and property ownership matters, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
